svg.title: The site
svg.desc: Path: /login, What it exercises: Username, password, "remember me". A wrong password shows an inline error. Success sets an HttpOnly, session-only nw_session cookie (plus a 30-day nw_remember when ticked) and redirects to /app or ?next=.; Path: /login/otp, What it exercises: Second step when two-step sign-in is on (--otp, or {"otp": true} on reset). The code is 424242.; Path: /app, What it exercises: Dashboard: nav, a row of cards (including Open tickets), recent orders, an Orders → link.; Path: /app/orders, What it exercises: 40 orders, 10 per page, rendered by JS from /api/orders?page=&status=. Prev and Next buttons, a status filter <select>, and Export CSV (/api/orders.csv, Content-Disposition: attachment).; Path: /app/orders/<id>, What it exercises: Order details. Refund order raises confirm(); accepting POSTs /api/refund.; Path: /app/settings, What it exercises: A React-style controlled Display name input (a direct .value write without an input event the framework accepts is reverted), a contenteditable Bio, a role=switch Email notifications toggle, and a <nw-color-picker> web component whose swatches are in shadow DOM. Save changes POSTs /api/settings.; Path: /app/iframe, What it exercises: The settings form inside a same-origin iframe. Saves from there are logged with source: "iframe".; Path: /app/upload, What it exercises: A styled Choose file… button that clicks a hidden <input type=file>. The upload is multipart; the server logs the file name and SHA-256 and returns a receipt code.
